name: aptely
description: Aptely — monorepo root (Backend API + FrontEnd). Orchestrates quality checks for CI and git hooks.

scripts.check:backend: npm --prefix Backend run lint && npm --prefix Backend run type-check && npm --prefix Backend run dead-code && npm --prefix Backend test
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix FrontEnd run lint && npm --prefix FrontEnd run type-check && npm --prefix FrontEnd run i18n:check && npm --prefix FrontEnd run dead-code && npm --prefix FrontEnd test
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
